targets.title: Singing it for “us”: Team passion displayed during national anthems is associated with subsequent success.
targets.evidence_quote:
The study described here is a close replication of Slater et al. (2018) and had two clear

goals.
targets.outcome_quote:
We

found no empirical support for the effect of passion on performance outcomes.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Overall verdict finds no support for the passion-performance effect; exploratory results do not override it.

reasoning: A new sample of FIFA World Cup anthems re-tests the Euro 2016 result. Analysis extensions use this new sample and do not constitute reproduction of the original data. Title and all authors match, with Mintra Bunditanukul replacing the abbreviated Minnie Bundit in the supplied metadata.
